This is a varied role where you'll be a key point of contact for new starters while providing essential HR support across the business.

Interested? Contact TurnerFox Recruitment or email your CV today.

title: HR Administrator
description:
24 hours a week (can be worked over 3 or 4 days)

Crowne Plaza Nottingham is looking for an HR Administrator to keep the people side of the hotel running accurately, on time, and with the right level of care for confidential information.

The Role

This role sits at the centre of the hotel's people processes - part data, part onboarding, part general manager support. You'll be the first point of contact for team member queries on people reporting, and the person making sure records, files and systems stay accurate as people join, move through, and leave the business. Day to day, you'll:
- Keep HR systems updated with accurate, current data, and run regular audits and data-cleansing across those systems
- Act as the first point of contact for Team Member queries relating to people reporting
- Develop and improve team reporting so it stays relevant as the business changes
- Support the recruitment process, helping Heads of Department set up interviews and communicate with candidates
- Deliver induction and onboarding for every new starter, so they get a proper welcome from day one
- Maintain a complete personnel file for each team member - application form, offer letter, contract, references, declarations, signed job description, induction receipt, working time directive documentation and right-to-work evidence
- Keep statutory training records current, and coordinate attendance on company training courses, including pre- and post-course briefings with managers
- Take minutes at management meetings, and type and distribute them accordingly
- Monitor sickness and absence levels, track lost productivity, and ensure return-to-work meetings happen promptly
- Provide administrative support to the General Manager, including letters, reports, meeting organisation and confidential material
- Coordinate travel arrangements, meetings and hotel planners across the team
- Handle telephone, email and face-to-face enquiries professionally and responsively
- Support the General Manager, Operations Manager and Department Managers with employee relations documentation and team member celebrations
- Keep Team Member notice boards, including the Internal Vacancy Board, tidy and up to date with current legislation and company information
- Coordinate work experience placements with local schools, colleges and universities
- Handle all confidential information professionally and discreetly at all times
- Follow cash and key handling, fire, security (including GDPR and PCI DSS), and Health & Safety procedures as laid down by the hotel and company
- Comply with hotel and company rules as set out in the team member handbook
- Represent the business's cultural values - passionate, real, inspiring, dynamic and enthusiastic - day to day

Supporting Your Hospitality Career Growth

We invest in the people who work with us. That includes apprenticeship routes into supervisory and management roles, ongoing on-the-job training, and recognition through our service awards for long-serving team members.

About the Hotel

Crowne Plaza Nottingham sits in the heart of Nottingham city centre, a 15-minute walk from Nottingham railway station and just five minutes from the Victoria Centre shopping area. The hotel is a popular choice for both business and leisure guests, with 210 bedrooms, 17 flexible meeting and event spaces catering for up to 400 guests, and the Urban Escape Spa offering a pool, jacuzzi, steam room and gym. Guests dine at the Lace Maker Restaurant for breakfast and Swatch Restaurant & Bar for lunch, dinner and drinks, and the hotel regularly hosts conferences, private events and celebrations for guests visiting the city, including those attending the nearby Royal Centre.

Benefits
- Discounted hotel stays and food & beverage across Valor Hospitality properties, for you and your friends/family
- Wellbeing support, including access to an Employee Assistance Programme
- Ongoing training and development, with clear routes into supervisory and management roles
- Recognition through long-service and performance awards
- Pension scheme and workplace perks in line with Valor Hospitality's standard offering

Ready to Join Us?

We're an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race disability, religion or belief, sexual orientation or age. At Valor Hospitality, we actively welcome applications from candidates of all diverse backgrounds.

Every application is carefully reviewed against the relevant skills and experience for the role, and we'll be in touch if you're a good match and have been selected for interview.

If you need any support at any stage of the recruitment process, or reasonable adjustments to help you do your best, please email our team at .

Please note that employment is subject to proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

title: People Services Coordinator
description:
People Services Coordinator
Full-Time Permanent Hybrid working

We're working with an established organisation looking to recruit a People Services Coordinator to join their HR team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a background in HR administration, people operations or a busy coordination role who enjoys working with people, keeping things organised and making sure processes run smoothly.

You'll play an important part in supporting the day-to-day HR function, helping to deliver a positive employee experience across the full employee lifecycle.

About the role

Working as part of a wider HR team, your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating onboarding and induction processes for new starters.
- Preparing contracts, employment documentation and contractual changes.
- Supporting employee lifecycle processes, including starters, leavers and internal changes.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and updating HR systems.
- Supporting payroll administration and ensuring employee information is accurate.
- Responding to general HR queries and providing support to employees and managers.
- Assisting with learning and development administration.
- Maintaining internal HR information, policies and guidance.
- Supporting the wider HR team with projects and process improvements.

We're keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Previous experience in HR administration, HR coordination or a similar administrative role.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.
- Good communication skills and a friendly, approachable manner.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office and internal systems.
- The ability to handle confidential information professionally.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to support the wider team.

A CIPD qualification or HR-related training would be beneficial, but isn't essential.

What's on Offer?

This is an opportunity to join a supportive team in a varied role where you'll gain exposure to different areas of HR and contribute to the smooth running of the People function.

It's particularly well suited to someone who enjoys the operational side of HR, takes pride in delivering a good service and is looking to continue developing their experience.

If you're currently working in HR administration or coordination and would be interested in hearing more, please get in touch for a confidential conversation.

Alternatively, apply today and we'll be in touch to discuss the opportunity in more detail.

title: Recruitment Resourcer
company: Thorn Baker Facilities Management - Agency - Permanent
description:
Recruitment Resourcer No previous Experience Needed!

Nottingham City Centre Monday Friday, 8am 5pm

Are you competitive, ambitious and ready to build a successful career?

Have you worked in hospitality, retail or sales? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love working towards targets and get a real buzz from achieving results?

We're looking for drive, determination and the right attitude not a CV full of recruitment experience!

We're looking for someone with a strong work ethic, a competitive nature and a genuine desire to learn, develop and build a fruitful long-term career in recruitment.

If you're resilient, self-motivated and ready to push yourself outside your comfort zone, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

What will you be doing?

As a Recruitment Resourcer, you'll play a key role in finding, attracting and connecting talented people with exciting career opportunities.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Finding top talent: Searching job boards, CV databases and LinkedIn to identify potential candidates.
- Attracting candidates: Creating engaging job adverts, building talent pools and exploring new ways to attract the right people.
- Building relationships: Speaking with candidates, conducting initial telephone screens and understanding their skills, motivations and career goals.
- Making things happen: Matching candidates to opportunities, keeping in touch with your talent network and generating new leads.
- Using your initiative: Exploring creative sourcing methods, building your LinkedIn network and staying ahead of the competition.
- Supporting the team: Helping the branch run smoothly and contributing to the overall success of the business.

You'll learn how to identify great talent, build relationships, manage a recruitment pipeline and develop the skills needed to succeed in a fast-paced, results-driven industry.

What we're looking for

Personality, attitude and potential matter more than experience.

We're looking for someone who:
- Has an exceptional work ethic and takes pride in what they do.
- Is competitive, target-driven and motivated by achieving results.
- Is resilient and doesn't give up when things get challenging.
- Is self-motivated, proactive and takes ownership of their responsibilities.
- Has the confidence to pick up the phone, speak to new people and build relationships.
- Is curious, coachable and genuinely wants to learn and improve.
- Wants more than just a job they want to build a rewarding career.

Experience in hospitality, retail or sales would be particularly suited to this role, especially if you're used to working under pressure, delivering great customer service, handling rejection or working towards targets.

No recruitment experience? No problem. We're interested in what makes you tick, what drives you and what you're prepared to put in to succeed.

Why consider a career in recruitment?

Recruitment is a people-focused, fast-moving industry where your communication skills, resilience and determination can make a real difference.

You'll have the opportunity to develop valuable commercial skills, learn from an experienced team and build a career where your ambition can take you further.

The details
- Location: Nottingham City Centre office-based
- Working hours: Monday to Friday, 8am 5pm
- Experience: No previous recruitment experience necessary

Ready to take the next step?

If you're hungry to succeed, enjoy a challenge and want to turn your drive and determination into a long-term career, we'd love to hear from you.

We're not looking for the finished article. We're looking for someone with the attitude and ambition to become one.

Apply today and let's see what you could achieve! Please attach a cover letter describing your fit for the role
